  validationRules:
    - id: report-name-present
      severity: error
      description: report_name is required for Regulatory Reporting Package extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: report_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: report_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: report_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(report_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: report-type-present
      severity: error
      description: report_type is required for Regulatory Reporting Package extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:

            field: report_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: report_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: report_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(report_type)) > 0
